contentHtml:
We have money back guaranteed treatment for Eczema, subject to terms and conditions.  In the first day of our treatment itself you will get some relief from itching.  If you are not improving in 2 or 3 days time, we will return your money including room rent and food, what else we can do for you?  The symptoms like redness, swelling, dryness, crusting, itching, flaking, blistering, oozing, cracking and bleeding will come down gradually. Usually we admit the patients for   three to four weeks, rare cases it may take some more time. In most cases within this time the symptoms will disappear. Our special treatment includes Panchakarma therapy including  Abhyangam (massage), Vamana, Virechana (medicated purgation),  internal medication and specially prepared herbal paste (lepam) for external application in the affected areas, etc… according to the patient’s medical condition.  We have specially prepared Ayurvedic/herbal/natural medicines for treatment of Eczema.      Our treatments help to remove the side effects of the medicines that you have taken earlier.    You can go to our testimonials page, there you can see the patients are writing or telling their experience, with their names and address, (photo if available) some of them may be known to you, or you may have some close friends near to them.  You can enquire personally.

Our challenging offer

If you believe that your Eczema is not curable, come to us, we will cure you. You can even pay after getting the result (no need to pay in the beginning of treatment) for more details regarding this offer visit our challenging offer page.

Things to follow

The patient must avoid hot foods and drinks, non veg. Alcohol.  Avoid sprays, cosmetics and powder.  It is better to avoid soft drinks, readymade foods, toffees, chocolates, etc… If you find anything allergic to you avoid it.. While taking bath use normal water, do not expose to heat or cold.

Benefits of our treatment

  1. Normally patients will feel relaxed in the first day of our treatment itself and within 2 or 3 days they will feel much better.
  2. More than 75% people will not feel any more itching, skin becomes smoother and soft, and there may not be any more bleeding within 2-3 weeks time.  Others may take some more time.  The speed of recovery depends on many factors including the severity of the problem, the age of the patient, how long the patient is suffering from this problem  etc..
  3. Our medications for   Eczema will help to remove toxins, inflammation, infection itching etc..
  4. Normally scars and marks all over the body due to eczema will disappear in 3 months time.
  5. Skin will regain its original color.
  6. Our treatment is having a long lasting effect..
  7. Our medicines are free from side effects.
  8. Our treatment helps to remove the side effects of medicines that you have taken earlier.

Duration of the treatment

Most cases the patient’s have to undergo the therapy for three to four weeks, others may take some more time. Everybody have to continue the medications for one to three year. Normally we reduce the medicines after 3 or 6 months.

What is Eczema?

Eczema is a form of chronic inflammation of the skin. Eczema is a range of persistent skin condition which includes dryness and recurring skin rashes, which are characterized by  one or more symptoms like redness, skin swelling, dryness, crusting, itching, flaking, blistering, oozing, cracking or bleeding.
